lastText.s3v4_title: Nemotron on a laptop caught 33 of 33 test scams
lastText.s3v4_next: Next: Pilot on T-Mobile's call servers, with a Capital One payee-risk feed.
lastText.s3v4_foot:
How we measured: 60 team-written synthetic scripts (33 scam, 27 legit), tuned on a separate dev set. Small sample. Test set re-scored after later fixes; a separate held-out set of 40 gave 20 of 20 and 1 of 20 false alarms.
Local Nemotron Nano 4B on a laptop GPU scores the live call; NVIDIA-hosted Nemotron is the fallback (never scored on our test set). On real phone calls the alert fired 12 to 15 s in.
